method.identity: Full input and return binary SHA plus every one of six recorded sample hashes. IDs, tokens, manifests, errors and numeric types are retained.
method.timing: First is separate; warm ON has two samples and warm OFF three. Raw samples, wall medians and separate ON stage medians retained. No percentile, significance or isolated instrumentation-overhead claim.
method.reference_limit: The benchmark reference road_tools shares current helper preloads. Its equality alone cannot prove old Projection equivalence. Cross-process A/B binaries and test_road_prepare_differential's independently frozen full chain must both pass.
method.scope: CPU preparation only. These numbers do not measure GPU, actual editor publication, HTTP response latency, memory or character traversal.
